questions.question:

questions.solution:

⇒ 7 + __**8 **____**× 0.5**__ - 6

⇒ __**7 + **____**4**__ - 6

⇒ __**11**____** - 6**__

⇒ **5**

II. 16 × 4 + 13 ÷ 2 - 3 ⇒ 16 ÷ 4 + 13 × 2 - 3

⇒ __**16 ÷ 4**__ + 13 × 2 - 3

⇒ 4 + __**13 × 2**__ - 3

⇒ __**4 + 26**__ - 3

questions.question: Swami Dayanand Saraswati was the founder of which of the following reform association?
questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**Arya Samaj**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__The Arya Samaj was established by Dayananda Saraswati in Mumbai on 10 April 1875.__

__
 
• It is a monotheistic Indian Hindu reform movement that promotes values and practices based on the belief of the Vedas.
 
• It was the first Hindu organization to introduce proselytization in Hinduism.
 
• Although never involved in politics, Swami Dayanand Saraswati was the source of inspiration for variety of political leaders during India's struggle for independence.
 
• For example, the call for '*Swarajya*' was used by him, and later taken by Lokmanya Tilak.
 
• Lala Lajpat Rai was a part of the organisation.
 
• The Indian Constitution adopted the call for abolition of caste system, untouchability, status of women. All of them were first preached by Arya Samaj.
 
• Today it has branches all over the world.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **Brahmo Samaj**

 
 
• The Brahmo Samaj was established in 1828 by Raja Ram Mohan Roy.
 
• The conflict between Keshab Chandra Sen and Debendranath Tagore was broadened in 1865 when Tagore allowed the Brahmos conducting services to wear their sacred threads. 
 
• Keshab objected to this decision and withdrew from the Brahmo Samaj along with his followers.
 
• He established the Brahmo Samaj of India on 15th November 1866.
 
• While on the other hand, Tagore grouped themselves in Adi Brahmo Samaj.
 
 

 
• Veda Samaj__

 
 
• Veda Samaj was established by the efforts of Keshab Chandra Sen and K. Sridharalu Naidu in 1864 at Madras.
 
• The Veda Samaj was inspired by the Brahmo Samaj. 
 
• It worked to abolish caste distinctions and promote widow remarriage and women’s education.
 
• Its members believed in one God. 
 
• They condemned the superstitions and rituals of orthodox Hinduism. 
 
 

 
• Prarthana Samaj:

 
 
• The Prarthana Samaj was founded in 1867 in Bombay by Dr. Atmaram Pandurang.
 
• It was an off-shoot of Brahmo Samaj.
 
• It was a reform movement within Hinduism and Justice M.G. Ranade and R.G. Bhandarkar joined it in 1870 and infused new strength to it.
 
• Mahadev Govind Ranade, also ran the Deccan Education Society.
 
• Several members of the Prarthana Samaj had earlier been active in the Paramhansa Mandali.
 
• This Samaj denounced idolatry, priestly domination, caste rigidities and preferred monotheism.
 
• It also concentrated on social reforms like inter-dining, inter-marriage, widow remarriage and uplift of women and depressed classes.
 
• Apart from Hindu sects, it also drew upon Christianity and Buddhism.
 
• It sought truth in all religions.
 
• Drawing inspiration from the Maratha Bhakti saints of the medieval period, Ranade sought to establish the concept of one compassionate God.
 
• Veeresalingam Pantulu was the Telugu reformer who encouraged the Prarthana Samaj in South India.

questions.question: If the ball, delivered by the bowler, not being a Wide, passes the striker without touching his/her bat or person, any runs completed by the batters from that delivery, or a boundary allowance, shall be credited as _________.
questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**Byes**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• In cricket,
 
 
• **byes** are runs that the batting team can score when the ball passes the batter without hitting their bat or body, and the fielders are unable to gather the ball in time to prevent the batsmen from completing the runs.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] **Important Points__** 

 
• Some other Cricket Terminologies
 
 
• **The Delivery**:

 
 
• A bowler delivers a ball that is not wide (it is within the acceptable range for the batter to play).
 
 
 
• **The Ball Passes the Batter**:
 
 
• If the ball passes the batter without touching their bat or person (such as their gloves, body, or pad), it is considered "not hit."
 
• This can happen if the batter misses the ball or if it is a legitimate delivery but the batter is not able to make contact.
 
 
 
• **Runs Scored**:
 
 
• If the batter and their partner run between the wickets during this delivery, these runs are counted as **byes**, not leg runs or any other type of runs. The reason for this is that the runs are completed despite the batter not making contact with the ball, which distinguishes byes from other types of runs, such as leg byes (which occur when the ball touches the batter's body).
 
 
 
• **Boundary Allowance**:
 
 
• If the ball crosses the boundary without being touched by any fielder (whether due to the batter missing or the ball being played in a way that no fielder can intercept it), the batsmen would be credited with a boundary (four or six), and this would also be added to the total score as **byes**.

questions.question: If 44 percent rate of compound interest compounded yearly is equivalent to the x percent rate of compound interest compounded half yearly, then what is the value of x ?
questions.solution:
**Given:**

Rate of interest compounded yearly = 44%

Rate of interest compounded half-yearly = x%

**Formula used:**

For compound interest compounded yearly: A = P(1 + r/100)t

For compound interest compounded half-yearly: A = P(1 + x/100)²t

Since the two rates are equivalent, we equate the two formulas:

(1 + 44/100) = (1 + x/100)²

**Calculation:**

Step 1: Simplify the left-hand side:

1 + 44/100 = 1.44

Step 2: Equate and solve for x:

1.44 = (1 + x/100)²

Step 3: Take the square root of both sides:

√1.44 = 1 + x/100

1.2 = 1 + x/100

Step 4: Solve for x:

1.2 - 1 = x/100

0.2 = x/100

x = 0.2 × 100

x = 20

**∴ The value of x is 20%.**
